name: City of Valletta
description: Valletta is Malta's tiny capital, set on a peninsula between the Grand Harbour and Marsamxett Harbour. The Knights of St John built it in the 16th century, after their defence against the Ottomans in the Great Siege, and named it for their leader, Jean Parisot de Valette. Massive bastions ring its Baroque churches, palaces and gardens, and 320 monuments are packed into just over half a square kilometre.
